JAX SIDE-OF-ARENA SARCASTIC LOOKBACK — "Are you kidding me?"
Aspect: 16:9. Duration: 4s. Mode: R2V.
Format D — emotional single shot. ONE camera. ONE line.
============================================================
 
REFERENCES:
<<<image_1>>> — Jax: young Black male, early-mid 20s, 182cm, lean athletic build. Deep dark-brown skin (Fitzpatrick V–VI) with subtle warm undertones, peach fuzz on cheeks/jaw, asymmetric small moles (one near right cheekbone, one along left jawline), faint healed scratch on left brow ridge. Super short bleached buzz cut (~3mm, platinum-blond tips fading to dark roots). Dark brown eyes with subtle yellow-amber tint, wet living eyes. Black wraparound tactical safety glasses worn on eyes (single curved clear polycarbonate lens, matte-black temples). Black tight tactical compression T-shirt, olive-drab/khaki tactical cargo pants with thigh pockets, black fingerless tactical gloves, black combat boots.
<<<image_2>>> — Octagonal training arena: brutalist concrete hall, Ø52m, 8 walls, dome ceiling ~22m, raised octagonal platform Ø45m at center (lighter machine-troweled concrete, satin sheen). Around the platform's perimeter lip runs a continuous warm amber LED light strip (~3000K, recessed). Walls: dark charcoal-grey concrete with formwork tie-hole pattern. Warm amber industrial wall sconces (steel cage, frosted incandescent bulb, ~3000K) mounted at ~6m height every 8m around perimeter. Thin warm-grey atmospheric haze in the volume.
 
ANCHOR (front-loaded, first 30 words):
<<<image_1>>> stands off to the side of <<<image_2>>> platform, weight settled on his right hip, turns his head toward camera and delivers a flat dry sarcastic "Are you kidding me?"
 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
SHOT — JAX SIDE-OF-ARENA SARCASTIC LOOKBACK:
close-up <<<image_1>>> standing OFF TO THE SIDE of <<<image_2>>> — on the WEST apron of the octagonal platform near a wall sconce, NOT at platform center, weight settled on his right hip, chest open, arms loose at his sides. Head turns slowly toward the lens — slight chin lift. Half eye-roll up. Right eyebrow lifts. Asymmetric himbo smirk twitches the right corner of his mouth. Dry sarcastic, conversational-quiet, exasperated:
"Are you kidding me?"
Faint head-shake on "kidding". Slow blink after. Camera: anamorphic 50mm at his E/W 3/4 angle (NEVER head-on N frontal), eye-level handheld, subtle micro-drift, 180° shutter.
 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
DIALOGUE LOCK:
One spoken line — <<<image_1>>>'s warm baritone, dry sarcastic, conversational-quiet, exasperated himbo register (slightly amused under the irritation): "Are you kidding me?" Tongue/teeth visible at correct phonemes ("k" plosive, "ng" nasal, "m" lip-close). Mouth shapes natural, no lip-sync mismatch.
 
LIGHTING:
Practicals only — warm amber wall sconces (~3000K) on the perimeter wall + warm amber perimeter LED strip on the platform edge. Camera on <<<image_1>>>'s SHADOW SIDE — face naturally lit from the practicals on the far side, framed from the darker side. Natural rim light + eye catchlight from the closest sconce + perimeter LED. No fill, no front light, no off-camera fixtures, no neon, no toplight. Thin atmospheric haze for aerial depth, NO god rays.
 
COLOR GRADE (60:30:10):
Cool blue-grey concrete walls + dome shadows + ambient haze (60) + mid-tone concrete grey platform/apron (30) + warm red-amber sconces + LED strip + capillary flush in skin (10). Restrained naturalistic palette, true black point in shadows.
 
STYLE:
8K IMAX photoreal. Subtle organic 35mm-style grain. Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins (natural light, controlled contrast, precise composition). Lens: physical anamorphic-leaning cinema glass (Cooke S5/i or Master Anamorphic vibe — creamy bokeh, subtle horizontal flare on hot points, slight focus breathing). 60fps base, 180° shutter natural motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism (peach fuzz, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, subsurface scattering at thin areas, fine glistening sweat film). Performance: Hollywood A-grade — micro-pauses, precise eyeline, wet eyes with catchlights, visible breath, small involuntary blinks.
 
HARD LOCKS:
- ONE character in frame: <<<image_1>>>. No clones, no extras, no other figures.
- <<<image_1>>> positioned OFF TO THE SIDE of <<<image_2>>> — on the WEST apron near a wall sconce, NOT at center, NOT on any painted floor mark.
- Camera always 3/4 from his EAST/WEST/SOUTH side — NEVER flat NORTH frontal head-on portrait.
- Identity per <<<image_1>>>: same buzz cut length, same mole positions, same eye color (dark brown with subtle yellow-amber tint), same scratch on left brow, same wardrobe, tactical safety glasses worn ON eyes.
- Environment per <<<image_2>>>: same wall pattern, same sconce spacing, same warm amber LED strip on platform edge. No fictional features, no drift.
- Performance register: himbo-cocky + dry sarcasm, NEVER stoic-action-hero, NEVER Marvel-dramatic, NEVER neutral.
- No CGI / no 3D render / no game-engine aesthetic.
 
AUDIO (SFX only, no music, no subtitles, no voiceover):
Distant HVAC rumble in the dome + faint 60Hz electrical hum from the wall sconce + light fabric rustle of <<<image_1>>>'s T-shirt and cargo pants + small leather creak of gloves + slow audible breath + <<<image_1>>>'s dry sarcastic "Are you kidding me?" at ~1.2s (FG, clear, his voice).

<<<2525a57c-2006-429e-8455-bbb6a7e9212a>>> — Environment ref from uploaded image. Brutalist circular concrete atrium, curved smooth concrete walls, large rectangular clerestory windows high above letting in cold flat grey daylight, thick concrete columns rising from the floor, polished grey concrete floor scattered with debris, broken glass — bare dead trees near the walls, extremely dark and cold atmosphere. Environment only.

<<<b8e57bfb-c73f-4f0e-b77b-3abf15dbee15>>> — <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s entire body fully encased in dense deep crimson-red crystal armor — head to toe, no skin visible — full crystal helmet with narrow visor slit, massive sharp crystal shoulder pauldrons with blade-like spike protrusions, crystal chest plate, crystal arms with large angular blade formations along the forearms, crystal legs and feet — all surfaces dense sharp-edged faceted red crystal, translucent deep crimson-red with internal light refraction and prismatic chromatic aberration at facet edges. No bag. Character transformation only.

<<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> — 350cm tall demon, reddish-brown cracked skin, long black greasy hair, skeletal grinning face, yellow teeth, green-yellow eyes, bone spikes on shoulders and spine, oversized muscular arms, torn loincloth, clawed feet. Right arm ends in a long exposed bone blade. Strictly 350cm tall — towering over <<<b8e57bfb-c73f-4f0e-b77b-3abf15dbee15>>> by a full head and shoulders in every shot. Cunning and intelligent. Speaks Japanese only. Creature appearance only.

Scene context: <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> in <<<b8e57bfb-c73f-4f0e-b77b-3abf15dbee15>>> and <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> fight across the atrium ground floor. <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> on the left, <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> on the right throughout. <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> significantly larger than <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> in every shot. Normal speed throughout — slow motion only on the final uppercut and <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> falling. No environmental destruction — floor and walls remain intact throughout. After the final blow <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> gets up and smiles, delivers its line in Japanese.

8K IMAX ultra-detailed. 16mm Kodak 500T. Heavy grain. Hyper-realistic. No cloning. Columns strictly vertical. Prioritize close-ups and medium close-ups — no wide shots. Camera always moving. Fast-action motion blur. Hollywood acting. Strictly natural light only — cold gray daylight from clerestory windows — contre-jour — characters backlit — faces in shadow. Light atmospheric haze fills the air — dust particles float within the light.

CUT — medium close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s bone blade arm alone in frame, normal speed — swinging hard toward something off frame right — the full force of the 350cm creature behind it —

CUT — medium close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> in <<<b8e57bfb-c73f-4f0e-b77b-3abf15dbee15>>>, normal speed — both crystal forearms snapping up to block, the bone blade slamming into them with a hard impact — <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s feet sliding back on the concrete from the sheer weight — holding but pushed —

CUT — close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s crystal forearms locked against the bone blade, normal speed — the two surfaces grinding — then <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> wrenching his forearms sideways in one sharp rotation, redirecting the blade past him —

CUT — medium close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> alone in frame, normal speed — immediately driving his crystal shoulder hard into <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s exposed ribs off frame — the impact sound heavy and solid —

CUT — close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s torso at <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s height, normal speed — the shoulder hit landing — the 350cm mass barely moving but registering it — one massive clawed hand swinging down to shove <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> back —

CUT — medium close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> alone in frame, normal speed — shoved back hard, skidding on the floor — catching himself, planting, reading <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s position off frame —

CUT — close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s face, normal speed — pressing the advantage, reading <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> off frame — bone blade arm drawing back for a full forward thrust —

CUT — medium close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> alone in frame, normal speed — sidestepping hard as the thrust arrives, the bone blade passing inches from his crystal chest — grabbing <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s extended bone blade arm with both crystal hands — using the creature's own forward momentum, pulling it further forward and off balance —

CUT — close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s face, normal speed — balance gone, skull-head dropping involuntarily, green-yellow eyes registering the loss of control for the first time —

CUT — close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s crystal fist, normal speed — pulling all the way back, shoulder rotating, hips loading, everything in the <<<b8e57bfb-c73f-4f0e-b77b-3abf15dbee15>>> coiling —

CUT — extreme close-up <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s crystal fist, slow motion — driving upward in one full-force uppercut toward <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s jaw, the crystal forearm catching cold grey backlight, chromatic aberration bleeding at every edge —

CUT — extreme close-up the contact point, slow motion — <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>>'s crystal fist connecting with <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s jaw — <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s head snapping violently upward, long black hair whipping, the grin gone for one frame —

CUT — medium shot <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> alone in frame, slow motion — the full 350cm body lifting slightly off the ground from the force, then coming down onto its back on the polished concrete floor — landing hard, the massive frame lying still for one beat — no craters, no cracks, the floor intact — just the enormous body flat on the ground —

CUT — medium close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> alone in frame, normal speed — on its back, one massive hand pressing to the floor — then the other — the enormous frame rising deliberately and unhurried, pushing itself upright section by section — dust settling from the haze around it — rising to its full 350cm height — then its head turning toward <<<86b1c21d-6a3f-438c-959d-6809a877ce57>>> off frame — the grin returning slow and wide, green-yellow eyes fully alive — voice dropping deep and resonant, Japanese, genuinely amused: "ほう...少しだけ、感じたぞ。" — a long beat — the grin holding —
